papers.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Response Selection for Open Domain Dialogue
papers.finding: Studies manually annotated real generator candidate pools; multiple valid positives and verified hard negatives improved response selection relative to compared adversarial data.
papers.application: Review actual training-only mT5 alternatives, especially role/polarity/time reversals, instead of relying mainly on unrelated random negatives.
papers.limit: Not a validation of this exact mT5 checkpoint, Singlish targets, or course pipeline.

papers.title: Dialogue Natural Language Inference
papers.finding: NLI-trained reranking reduced persona contradictions in their dialogue experiments.
papers.application: Validate a contradiction-aware score using explicitly attributed You/Peer facts to downrank e.g submitted->not-submitted and unavailable->available.
papers.limit: Persona consistency differs from full conversation reasoning, ownership and numerical comparison; NLI is a fallible model.

papers.title: Lexically Constrained Decoding for Sequence Generation Using Grid Beam Search
papers.finding: Grid beam search enforces supplied words/phrases during token-by-token generation; demonstrated in translation.
papers.application: Require critical English-draft time/amount tokens to remain in LOCAL generation; additionally validate that new conflicting values did not appear.
papers.limit: Forcing08:10 to appear does not preserve negation, before/after or ownership; translation results do not establish Singlish performance.

papers.title: A Diversity-Promoting Objective Function for Neural Conversation Models
papers.finding: MMI-based objectives/decoding strategies target generic conversational responses; reported automatic andhuman gains on their datasets.
papers.application: Candidate scoring can penalize replies that are probable regardless of context.
papers.limit: Project already has older MMI/generic/copy/marker reranking code; previous surface metrics are not semantic-quality proof. Not a new untried project idea.

proposed_first_experiment.measure_first: Independent manual acceptable-candidate coverage, allowing multiple plausible replies; no exact authored-intent matching.
proposed_first_experiment.training_labels: Only training-conversation candidates with reviewed appropriate/inappropriate judgments; new24evaluation examples and lockedtest remain excluded.
proposed_first_experiment.local_pipeline: Rank English first; then render selected English toLOCAL; preserve actualchosenanchor and apply rewrite-only number/time consistency checks.
proposed_first_experiment.fallback: If every available candidate is unacceptable, reranking cannot create a good answer; reject/regenerate or use a clearly identified fallback.
proposed_first_experiment.success: Higher human-reviewed contextual usefulness and English/LOCAL fidelity on held-out conversations, not lower pairloss or moreparticles.

status: Research and examples prepared; no new training, checkpoint download, friend messages or deployment change
